reviews.text: Wonderful vet. Very professional doctors who deal with my difficult anxious dog so kindly

Hello 😊
Thank you so much for your 5 stars ✨
Best regards,
The Mon Véto Paris 17 Team …
Highly competent and extremely kind staff

Dr. Roche Naude has been my veterinarian for over 25 years. Active in animal welfare, adopting rescue dogs and cats, Dr. Roche Naude has always worked wonders on the various and sometimes serious illnesses he has treated. I've followed him through all his moves.

That's how I also met Dr. Chefneux and Dr. Eid, who share the same values ​​and quality of care as Dr. Roche Naude.
The veterinary assistants are just like the doctors. They are all welcoming, helpful, and kind, but also comforting during difficult times.
I highly recommend the Ouest my Vet clinic.
They are all wonderful, and I sincerely thank them for everything they have done for Dédé, Jojo, Gabana, Étoile, Félix, Eden, Whisky, Orphée, and their most precious rescue, my beautiful Princess! THANK YOU 🙏🏻
A very nice english speaking gentleman helped us with finding Hills +Dental chicken flavor. He also answered questions about taking our cat to the UK. Merci beaucoup!

Mistreatment; my cat's condition is worsening despite nearly €400 spent in just a few weeks.
The vet who passed me by while I was explaining to reception that my cat's condition was deteriorating didn't even speak to me, except to insist that the cat was indeed the right food.

Anyway, I made an appointment at the cat clinic in the 15th arrondissement, which immediately hospitalized my cat for three days in critical condition. They explained that the treatment she received at Saint Ferdinand was inappropriate, and it's no wonder her condition continued to worsen. She's already doing better since switching clinics.
I don't even want to imagine what would have happened if I had continued at Saint Ferdinand; the level of empathy and competence seems limited for serious illnesses.

Nevertheless, I want to thank the reception staff, who were wonderful.

Hello, we are sorry to hear that your experience at Clinique Vétérinaire Ouest My Vet Paris did not meet your expectations. Please do not hesitate to contact us so we can better understand your disappointment. Sincerely, Clinique Vétérinaire Ouest My Vet Paris.
The clinic staff are very professional and kind, and the value for money is excellent. They always give good advice.

We had our dog operated on by Dr. Roche-Naude: perfect!

The team is truly highly competent: Ouest My Vet (Place St. Ferdinand, Paris 17th arrondissement) is really the ideal veterinary clinic. We sincerely thank Dr. Roche-Naude.

A really lovely clinic and shop! They have a wide selection of products, and the welcome is pleasant and warm. You can tell the team is passionate about their work and genuinely cares about animal welfare. It's a pleasure to entrust your companions to such dedicated people.
A top-notch veterinary clinic where we, like our furry friend, go with a smile.

First vet visit for our dog, Oreo. I was pleasantly surprised by the appointment: Dr. Chefneux was warm, very attentive, and really took the time to get to know her. He was very gentle and explained everything clearly. This is very reassuring for future visits, as I now know he will be the one taking care of our dog.

I also appreciate that the team at this veterinary clinic always responds very quickly to emails and calls. It's reassuring to feel heard and to receive good advice so quickly! 🙏

A huge thank you to Dr. Eid and the veterinary assistants for their care of my cat during his final days, their professionalism, and their kindness.

A truly compassionate team that I wholeheartedly recommend.

They're only good at treating healthy animals and taking your money!!!!!
Lack of compassion, practically no psychology!!!!! In short, avoid them... or rather, run away
Excellent clinic, whether for an emergency or a simple consultation. I highly recommend it.

I thank the entire team for their professionalism and love of animals.

On Monday morning, my Maine Coon cat was in bad shape with a paralyzed pelvis, and I was immediately taken to the clinic. They suspected a stroke, which was confirmed.
The doctor examined her thoroughly (X-rays, etc.) and gave her an injection. I was able to take her home, and she was already feeling better the very next day. 🙏🏻

My little dog loves this bright and lively place. She forgives injections and other discomforts very quickly because the examination is gentle, affectionate, and respectful. And I find the two veterinarians I know to be very competent and friendly.
Excellent advice
Great, my timid cat let me do it and I was able to feel reassured!

Very professional and gentle with my dog. He had surgery and was well cared for.
Spoke French and English.

As a client of Dr. Roche Naude since Ouest My Vet opened, I am absolutely delighted with the care my dachshunds receive. This veterinarian is simply exceptional: possessing remarkable expertise, rare kindness, and a keen eye for detail. At every consultation, Dr. Roche Naude demonstrates exemplary commitment and a genuine passion for animal welfare, which is incredibly reassuring.

The modern and perfectly equipped premises reflect the professionalism and excellence of this practice. Whether it's for simple routine checkups or more complex situations, I am always impressed by the care, attentiveness, and focus given to my companions.

Dr. Roche Naude and the Ouest My Vet team embody veterinary excellence. Thanks to them, my companions have benefited from exceptional care for years, and I couldn't imagine entrusting them to anyone else. Thank you so much for your dedication and unparalleled expertise!
Thank you to the vets for their kindness, welcome, and competence (Our little Sam)
Excellent, attentive, dedicated and efficient team of veterinarians
Patient was well received, very professional
